competences.description: Attacks the enemy to decrease the Attack Bar by 20% with a 50% chance. If the Attack Bar was not decreased, increases the Attack Bar of the ally with the highest Attack Bar by 10%.

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: If the Attack Bar was not decreased, of the ally with the highest Attack Bar.

competences.description: Removes 1 harmful effect on all allies and recovers their HP by 20%. In addition, increases the Attack Bar of all allies by 15% if no harmful effects were removed.

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: if no harmful effects were removed

competences.description: Removes all harmful effects on the ally target, increases its Attack Bar by 20% per harmful effect removed, and resets its skill cooldown. [Authority of Justice] is not affected by cooldown increasing or decreasing skills.

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more
Not affected by cooldown increasing or decreasing skills
